Starting my first Souls game ever - Dark Souls 1.

You probably won't need to level up both strength and dexterity equally. First time going around a new corner or into a new room, maybe keep your shield held up. A lower equipment load gives you a better roll speed.

Warrior, master key, focus on vitality, don't get too encumbered to roll properly and learn to use your shield. Don't be afraid to upgrade weapons with titanite shards, they're pretty common. I upgraded my beginning sword to level five before replacing it. You may need to look up how to kindle bonfires and use humanity since most new players can't figure that out on their own. Also, maybe play offline, online can be a little frustrating now that most people playing have already beaten the game. Oh, also, don't bother saving your souls unless planning on using them for something, better to level up than lose all your hard work.

Humanity is one of the resources that you may run out of quickly if you like playing multiplayer. So early on, you can farm most rats for humanity so long as you haven't killed that area's boss behind the fog wall yet. See if you can find a group of rats that are close to a bonfire and make trips back and forth, get ten hard humanity (the item named Humanity, not the number by your health and stamina) or so before moving on to the next area.

Get enough stats to carry one myrical and get heal. Good for early game. Also item description tells you lore. Lastly vitality and endurance are the two most important stats. Have fun, play smart and slow. If you treat it like a traditional RPG hank n' slash you're going to have a bad time. Don't be afraid to explore you'll find all sorts of cool stuff.

Drop down below the elevator in firelink shrine that links to the parish for some neat items.

Find a weapon that you like the move set on and upgrade that. You can get through the entire game with your starting weapon.

Play online if you can. It adds fun to be worry about being invaded, it's fun to invade and get help. If you invade someone give a bow before fighting them. Don't be a troll.

Stop every once in awhile and look around, listen to the music. Dark Souls has one of my favorite soundtracks of all time and the game is very pretty.

Don't use your soul consumables until right before you use them so you don't lose them in death.

technically you can get through the graveyard at the beginning but it is very difficult and can't really be done until you start new game +. But if you're hell bent you need a holy weapon to kill those skeletons (which you won't have) and to stop them from spawning you need to kill a guy inside the catacombs. I did it on new game plus to see what happened and from a story line/lore perspective it was interesting.

If you are playing and don't really know what the story is and want to know there are some great youtube videos that tell the lore and gave me a good outlook on the game. here is one.

If you find yourself in a fight with anymore than 3 baddies you are probably in trouble. Try to fight one on one as much as possible. Dodge and wait for an opening to attack. Carry a bow or ranged weapon of some sort to pull enemies.

You can summon players to help but you can also summon NPCs for bosses. You need to be human to see their summon signs and you need to meet them in the world or do certain events to have their sign appear.

Every NPC can be killed. This can help you by getting good weapons or items but it can hurt you because vendors will not sell to you afterward.

The game is hard but it is also fair and generally really consistent. If you die it's most likely because you messed up somewhere (not high enough level, didn't save stamina to dodge) rather than the game rubber banding and killing you to be cruel.
